title: bug: report_blocked turns every task id mentioned in the reason into a hard wait, even next to an explicit blockedOnTaskIds
description:
Observed on 2026-10-30 at 13:32Z on task-b1aecb5403e64f4596bffbce7c36739c. worker-55e6716a called report_blocked, and its reason named the real blocker (task-6f3f7fe9…, a live peer's RED tests). It also mentioned, informationally, a separate bug it had just filed ("filed task-cf7f470818b34486b4e74bacc1b92c7a"). The daemon recorded blockedOnTaskIds = [6f3f7fe9, cf7f4708], so the row won't auto-unblock until an unrelated, still-unplanned bug row lands. A governor has to clear it by hand.

Root cause: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.ts (around lines 159-181) always unions three sets: the stored ids, the explicitly supplied blockedOnTaskIds, and every id TASK_ID_IN_REASON_RE matches in the reason. A caller has no way to mention a related task id without creating a dependency.

Expected:
- When the caller supplies blockedOnTaskIds explicitly, that list is authoritative and the reason is not parsed.
- Auto-parsing stays only as the legacy fallback, when no explicit list is supplied.
- The response reports which ids were parsed vs supplied, so a seat can see what it is waiting on.
- Update the tool description, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, and the worker role docs (docs/roles/worker*.md: "pass blockedOnTaskIds explicitly") to match.
definitionOfDone: report_blocked with an explicit blockedOnTaskIds records exactly those ids (plus stored ones on a repeat call). Task ids that appear only in the reason are not added. A regression test covers it.
report_blocked with no blockedOnTaskIds still auto-parses task ids from the reason, so existing legacy-style blocks behave as before. A regression test covers it.
The tool description, docs/MCP_SERVER.md and the worker role guidance describe the explicit-list-wins rule, and the daemon test suite passes.

implementationPlan.description: Test-first in existing reportBlocked.test.ts fixtures: replace the old mixed supplied+reason-union expectation with explicit-list precedence. Fresh call blockedOnTaskIds:[realBlocker] plus reason mentioning unrelated filed task must record only realBlocker; omission still parses both legacy reason ids with current boundary/case rules. Explicit [] must suppress parsing; invalid null/non-array/non-string retains INVALID_INPUT with zero writes/pages. Repeat calls preserve stored ids and union only explicit new ids, including [] with an informational reason; assert blockedFromStatus/blockedAt/seat and idempotent paging semantics unchanged. Include explicit already-satisfied ids plus unrelated unmet reason -> dependenciesSatisfied:true/no block; retain unknown/self/cycle/cap/filter controls. Verify runDependencyUnblock releases the incident-shaped row when the real blocker completes even while unrelated row remains WORKING. Assert new response provenance separately from actually recorded ids.

In reportBlocked.ts use the existing presence criterion params.blockedOnTaskIds !== undefined, not array length: after unchanged validation, compute parsedFromReason only when no explicit list was supplied. Candidate merge is stored + (supplied OR parsed); preserve existing dedupe/order/cap, unknown handling, self/cycle guard, strict delivery satisfaction, resource-first behavior, status/ownership and error handling. Add additive response arrays suppliedBlockedOnTaskIds and parsedBlockedOnTaskIds to BOTH dependency-evaluating return shapes (dependenciesSatisfied and blocked/repeat). They contain first-occurrence unique normalized INPUT candidates before existence/cycle/satisfaction filtering; explicitly supplied [] yields both empty arrays, reason ids are never parsed in explicit mode. Existing blockedOnTaskIds/ignored/satisfied/dropped fields remain authoritative outcomes. Resource-granted early returns do not evaluate dependencies and therefore omit these arrays; queued-resource path uses the same selection. Update top regex comment, tool description, parameter description and dependenciesSatisfied nextAction wording so none falsely says explicit calls also parse reason. No schema/state migration or generic dependency helper refactor.

Update docs/MCP_SERVER.md report_blocked semantics, inputs and BOTH dependency response examples to distinguish supplied vs legacy-parsed candidates, explicit [] suppression, preserved stored ids on repeats, and filtering before recording. Update existing worker.md blocker guidance IN PLACE to say always pass blockedOnTaskIds explicitly (including [] for no task dependencies); worker.reference.md explains informational ids and repeat-union behavior. Keep worker.md <=40 lines; remove contradictory old union/auto-parse wording in these sections without rewriting unrelated seat lifecycle advice. No edits to generated initFiles.ts or .moe copies; generator picks up canonical role sources.

Concentrated verification in an isolated snapshot with native dependencies and inherited MOE_* scrubbed, not the live linked dist: `(cd packages/moe-daemon && npm run build && npm test) && npm run docs:lint`. Full daemon suite is required by DoD and additive MCP response change. Submit fresh exact command/exitCode/outputTail with counts, no prior passing result substituted. Ensure tests fail against previous unconditional parsing, existing resource/seat/cycle/strict-delivery/idempotent tests stay passing, and build regenerates roles only in snapshot. Changes are OS-independent TS/docs; Windows-specific filesystem code is unchanged, but no shell-only test fixture dependency is introduced.

Final adversarial self-review: absent vs [] vs invalid values, reason containing current/unknown/cyclic/satisfied/unrelated ids, repeated calls with stored dependencies, cap ordering, resource grant/queue, ownership rejection and chat failure. Confirm explicit reason-only mentions cannot become hard waits or cycle warnings, legacy behavior remains when omitted, provenance cannot be mistaken for persisted dependencies, and no accidental clearing of stored holds or extra paging occurs. Check concise five-file task diff <=400 net lines, fix findings and rerun the named gate before complete_task/QA.

reopenReason: Governor unblock. The Codex seat correctly handed this delivery-only rework back. It needs a one-shot CLAUDE worker: follow QA's recipe in comment-46a31f6c, i.e. an Edit-tool touch of docs/MCP_SERVER.md plus the initFiles.ts regen in a clone. A Codex, Gemini or Grok seat that claims it should report_blocked straight away with no edits, as worker-6e57c4f8 did, and I'll requeue it.

task-f084cbe1 (the pins/ gitignore generator row) now depends on this row. It regenerates after you reach DONE and reports those lines as catch-up. If your review asks this row to regenerate instead, f084cbe1's delta stays clean.

4. Copy src/generated/initFiles.ts back.

4. Check afterward: `git show --stat <completion>` lists docs/MCP_SERVER.md and initFiles.ts, and `git diff -- docs/MCP_SERVER.md` is empty.
